_comment: Download sizes setup.sh shows when the Hugging Face API is unreachable (bytes; 2026-10-20; ornith1.5 and nemotron-super-vl 2026-10-22: the whole Hub repository at the pinned revision, from the Hugging Face API). pending_publication: the Hugging Face repository is not public yet, so there is no revision to pin; setup serves only a local copy (--models-dir) until the revision is recorded and the marker removed. checkpoints: the whole HF repository at the listed revision. packages: the Linux x86_64 / CPython 3.13 artifacts of release/requirements-0.32.lock (PyPI file sizes). wheel: release/merlin-wheel.sha256's wheel. venv_factor: installed size over download size, an estimate for the disk check. drafters: the speculative drafter setup.sh --spec dflash2 fetches (the whole Hub repository at the pinned revision, 2026-10-23, from the Hugging Face API; its checksum list is models/flash-next/dflash2.sha256).

int6._comment: The Flash-Next family's one INT6 g32 PLE pack (8 shards + ple-int6-pack.json; models/flash-next/ple-int6-pack.sha256), laid over the FP8 checkpoint of each qualified member by setup (tools/merlin/ple_pack.py; flash-next and swift1.5; swift1.5-huihui is not qualified). Public on Hugging Face since 2026-11-02; the pinned revision carries the re-emitted manifest (ple-int6-pack.json, 34,695 bytes; the 8 shards are unchanged). files/bytes: 41,600,199,680 table bytes; 41,600,274,991 with headers and the manifest.
